style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern school playground, clear unfair bullying with no violence. Two taller older children take over a small younger child's marble-game space: one places his own large collection box across the younger child's little game circle while scooping away the smaller child's few plain colored marbles with a broad hand; the other stands over the space with folded arms, imposing physically. Younger child sits to side with empty little pouch, distressed and intimidated, clearly deprived of game pieces. Strength used unfairly to seize resources from weaker child, not voluntary sharing or normal winning. A teacher in background notices and approaches to intervene, but main focus remains stronger children taking the weaker child's belongings. No hitting, injuries or weapons. Realistic grounded poses and five fingers, physically plausible marbles on flat pavement, coherent hands touching objects. 3:2 landscape, pencil watercolor colored pencil ivory paper, no text letters logos numbers brands watermarks.
alt: 兩名高大的孩子霸占較小孩子的彈珠場地，把他的彈珠拿走；小孩子拿著空袋難過地坐在旁邊，老師正走來。
